label: Outcome-first prompting
description: Prompt design that starts from the desired result, constraints and success criteria.

label: Retrieval budget
description: Rules that limit and justify search iterations in grounded answers.

label: XML prompt structure
description: Using XML-like tags to separate instructions, examples, documents and inputs.

label: Few-shot prompting
description: Providing multiple examples to steer format, tone or task behavior.

label: ReAct
description: Reasoning plus tool actions with observations used to update the next step.

label: Spaces
description: Dedicated context environments with instructions and reference materials.

label: Validation loop
description: Prompt or agent pattern that checks work using tests, schema validation or explicit criteria.

label: Hidden prompts
description: Context supplied to the model by the application but not intentionally displayed to the user; useful for behavior and session data but not safe for secrets.

label: Prompt hacking
description: Attempts to bypass instructions, override system behavior, or extract hidden context; requires defense in depth beyond prompting.

label: Context assembly
description: Selecting and structuring authorized, relevant, sufficient and traceable context before a model call.

label: Semantic search / RAG
description: Retrieving semantically relevant documents or summaries and inserting them into context for grounded generation.

label: Command grammars
description: Controlled command vocabulary that lets a model generate parseable tool programs with validated arguments.

label: Data embedding formats
description: Choices for representing external data in prompts: lists, tables, JSON, delimited free text and relational tables.

label: Programmatic consumption
description: Designing model output for downstream code, UI or automation using parseable structures and validation.

label: Reasoning output control
description: Separating intermediate reasoning, concise explanation and final answer so products can balance reliability, cost, privacy and UX.

label: Fine-tuning as last resort
description: Using fine-tuning only after prompt design, examples, retrieval and validation fail to meet requirements; avoid real customer data.

label: Citation IDs
description: Stable IDs attached to citeable records or chunks so outputs can list sources_used and claims can be traced.

label: Context filtering
description: Filtering retrieved or session data before the model call so only authorized and necessary information enters the context.

label: Data exfiltration
description: Leakage of data the user is not authorized to see, often caused by over-broad context, weak retrieval filtering or unsafe tool access.

label: Give a Bot a Fish
description: Pattern where the application directly supplies all relevant data and constraints in the model context.

label: Hidden prompt leakage
description: Risk that hidden instructions, session data or internal context passed to the model appears in the user-visible output.

label: Hypothetical Document Embeddings
description: Retrieval technique that generates a hypothetical answer document from a query and uses its embedding to retrieve real documents.

label: Jailbreak
description: Attempt to make the model ignore behavioral constraints, role instructions, formatting rules or safety limits.

label: JSON as context
description: Using JSON for nested, irregular or programmatically consumed data in the prompt.

label: Markdown table as context
description: Using Markdown tables for compact representation of homogeneous records in prompt context.

label: Nested JSON context
description: Representing nested entities in JSON when relationships are internal to an object.

label: Output validation
description: Validating structured model outputs for syntax, required fields, allowed values, IDs and permissions before use.

label: Programmatic LLM output
description: LLM output designed for software consumption rather than only human reading.

label: Prompt injection
description: Attack where untrusted content read by the model contains instructions that attempt to override higher-priority instructions.

label: Prompt leakage
description: Disclosure of internal prompt text, hidden context, retrieved records or operational instructions.

label: Relational prompt context
description: Representing related data as tables with explicit IDs when nested JSON is too verbose.

label: Source traceability
description: Ability to trace generated claims back to source documents, chunks or records.

label: Synthetic data for fine-tuning
description: Using synthetic, anonymized or authorized data for fine-tuning to reduce privacy and memorization risks.

label: Teach a Bot to Fish
description: Pattern where the model receives controlled tools or commands to retrieve information or act across multiple steps.

label: Tool command abstraction
description: Choosing tool primitives that are composable and validable without being too low-level or too task-specific.

label: Tool validation
description: Checking model-proposed tool calls or commands against schemas, permissions and risk rules before execution.

label: Untrusted content
description: Content that should be analyzed as data, not followed as instruction, such as web pages, emails, PDFs or RAG results.

label: LLM guardrails
description: Guardrail controls applied around an LLM application to block, validate, mask, or route risky inputs and outputs.

label: Runtime safety
description: Safety enforced during the application pipeline rather than only through prompt wording.

label: Validate prompt
description: Pre-model validation of user input or assembled prompt before an LLM call.

label: Validate response
description: Post-generation validation of model output before it is shown to a user or used by software.

label: Prompt injection detection
description: Runtime detection of attempts to manipulate an LLM or LLM application through adversarial instructions.

label: Jailbreak detection
description: Detection of attempts to override safety instructions, persona constraints or system prompts.

label: Instruction manipulation
description: Attempts to leak, ignore or override the system prompt or application prompt template.

label: Hallucination detection
description: Runtime evaluation of whether a generated response is faithful to user input and source context.

label: Intrinsic hallucination
description: A response that directly contradicts the provided source context.

label: Extrinsic hallucination
description: A response that introduces information not present in the provided context, even if it might be true generally.

label: Claim-by-claim evaluation
description: Evaluating each factual claim in a response against the available context to localize unsupported information.

label: Sensitive data leakage
description: Inadvertent exposure of confidential or private information in a prompt or response.

label: PII leakage
description: Exposure of personally identifiable information in LLM inputs, context or outputs.

label: Direct identifier
description: A data element that can uniquely identify a person by itself.

label: Quasi-identifier
description: A data element that can identify a person when combined with other data.

label: Custom guardrail rule
description: Organization-defined guardrail for specific patterns, keywords, domains or risks.

label: Regex rule
description: Custom rule that matches variable text patterns using regular expressions.

label: Keyword rule
description: Custom rule that matches specified words or phrases.

label: Default rules
description: Guardrail rules applied globally across tasks or applications.

label: Task rules
description: Guardrail rules applied to a specific LLM application or use case.
